note: site_audit_report_entity (submodule of site_audit) defines the revisionable content entity 'site_audit_report' (base table site_audit_report) with base fields label, uri, data (serialized audit JSON). Routes under /admin/reports/site-audit/reports; settings config site_audit_report_entity.settings (key 'example'); permissions create/view/edit/delete + 'administer site audit report'. Static helpers: SiteAuditReport::saveReport()/sendReport()/audit(). Medium cases read a known entity label / a known settings value; hard cases create a report entity and grant a role the view permission, verified against live state.

evals.prompt: What does the site_audit_report_entity submodule add to a Drupal site, and where can saved audit reports be viewed?
evals.expected_output: It adds a revisionable content entity type 'site_audit_report' so audit runs can be saved, listed, viewed and kept over time. The collection is at /admin/reports/site-audit/reports; each report stores a label, site uri, and the serialized audit data.

evals.prompt: Which permissions does the site_audit_report_entity module define for controlling access to saved site audit reports?
evals.expected_output: create site audit report, view site audit report, edit site audit report, delete site audit report, and administer site audit report (the entity's admin permission, restricted).

evals.prompt: How can I save the result of a site audit as an entity programmatically using the site_audit_report_entity module?
evals.expected_output: Call the static helper SiteAuditReport::saveReport($label, $revision_log) (Drupal\site_audit_report_entity\Entity\SiteAuditReport), which runs a full audit and saves a new site_audit_report entity; its absolute URL is on $entity->link. For a fixture without running an audit, SiteAuditReport::create(['label'=>..., 'data'=>[]])->save().

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a saved site_audit_report entity. Inspect the live site and report the label of that saved report.
evals.expected_output: A site_audit_report entity exists with label SARE_Known_Report (query the site_audit_report storage / entity type).

evals.prompt: Inspect the site_audit_report_entity module's settings configuration on this live site and report the value stored in its 'example' setting.
On this Drupal site, create a saved site_audit_report entity with the label 'SARE_Task'. Apply the change to the live site (you do not need to run a real audit; an empty data payload is fine).
evals.expected_output: Create a site_audit_report entity labelled SARE_Task, e.g. SiteAuditReport::create(['label'=>'SARE_Task','data'=>[]])->save(). Verify checks at least one site_audit_report entity with that label exists.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a role with the machine name 'sare_viewer' and grant it the site_audit_report_entity permission that lets it view saved site audit reports. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create role sare_viewer and grant it 'view site audit report' (e.g. Role::create(['id'=>'sare_viewer','label'=>'SARE Viewer'])->grantPermission('view site audit report')->save(), or drush role:create + drush role:perm:add). Verify checks the role exists and has that permission.
